result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. It grants the Company a 30-day convenience right but omits the required pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, leaves HDI's apparent 90-day termination right unrestricted to term end, and directly conflicts with subsection (a), which still requires a Termination Payment whenever the Company terminates. The new right to terminate “in whole or in part” also exceeds the requested position and may alter commercial scope. The margin comment does not cure these defects.
